name: Pregnenolone 25 mg Slow-Release Capsules (LoxOral)
title: Pregnenolone 25 mg Slow-Release Capsules (LoxOral)

title: Testosterone 0.1%–10% Topical Cream (VersaBase)

name: Testosterone Cypionate 200 mg/mL Injection (10 mL vial)
title: Testosterone Cypionate 200 mg/mL Injection (10 mL vial)

name: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) Injection (Pregnyl)
title: HCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin) Injection (Pregnyl)
desc: Often prescribed alongside testosterone to help maintain the body's own testosterone production and testicular function, or on its own for fertility and natural testosterone support. Reconstituted and injected subcutaneously per the prescriber's schedule.

name: Anastrozole 1 mg Tablets (10 count)
title: Anastrozole 1 mg Tablets (10 count)
desc: An aromatase inhibitor used with testosterone therapy to limit conversion of testosterone to estrogen, helping manage water retention, mood and other estrogen-related side effects. Dosed one to three times weekly as directed.

name: Latanoprost 0.05% / Minoxidil 5% / Finasteride 0.1% / Biotin 0.1% / Melatonin 0.1% Shampoo (VersaBase)
title: Latanoprost 0.05% / Minoxidil 5% / Finasteride 0.1% / Biotin 0.1% / Melatonin 0.1% Shampoo (VersaBase)

title: Minoxidil 10% / Finasteride 0.1% / Tretinoin 0.025% / Fluocinolone 0.025% Topical Solution

name: Minoxidil 5% / Melatonin 0.1% / Finasteride 0.1% / Tretinoin 0.05% Scalp Solution
title: Minoxidil 5% / Melatonin 0.1% / Finasteride 0.1% / Tretinoin 0.05% Scalp Solution
desc: Adds topical melatonin, studied for its antioxidant effect on follicles, to the minoxidil/finasteride/tretinoin combination.

name: Finasteride 1 mg Tablets (10 count)
title: Finasteride 1 mg Tablets (10 count)
desc: The oral DHT-blocker for male-pattern hair loss, taken once daily. Blocks the hormone that shrinks hair follicles, slowing loss and supporting regrowth over 3–6 months of consistent use.

name: Tadalafil 22 mg Rapid Dissolve Tablet (RDT-Plus)
title: Tadalafil 22 mg Rapid Dissolve Tablet (RDT-Plus)

title: Sildenafil 25 mg / Tadalafil 10 mg Troche

title: Sildenafil 25 mg / Apomorphine 2 mg Troche

name: Tadalafil 20 mg / Oxytocin 10 Units Sublingual Tablet
title: Tadalafil 20 mg / Oxytocin 10 Units Sublingual Tablet
desc: Tadalafil paired with oxytocin, the hormone associated with bonding and sexual response, in a small sublingual tablet.

title: Alprostadil 500 mcg / 0.1 mL / DMSO Topical-Urethral Gel

name: Papaverine 30 mg/mL / Phentolamine 1 mg/mL Injection (Bimix)
title: Papaverine 30 mg/mL / Phentolamine 1 mg/mL Injection (Bimix)

title: Papaverine 16.7 mg/mL / Phentolamine 0.56 mg/mL / Alprostadil 5.6 mcg/mL Injection (Low-Dose Trimix)

title: Papaverine 30 mg/mL / Phentolamine 1 mg/mL / Alprostadil 10 mcg/mL Injection (Standard Trimix)

title: Progesterone 10–100 mg/g Topical Gel (VersaBase Anhydrous HRT)

title: Progesterone 100 mg Slow-Release Capsules (LoxOral)

name: Progesterone 200 mg Slow-Release Capsules

title: Progesterone 100 mg Rapid Dissolve Tablet (RDT-Plus)
desc: Progesterone in a tablet that dissolves in the mouth, absorbed through the cheek and bypassing first-pass liver metabolism. A good option for women who don't absorb oral capsules well.

name: DHEA 25 mg Slow-Release Capsules (LoxOral)
title: DHEA 25 mg Slow-Release Capsules (LoxOral)
desc: Oral DHEA in a slow-release capsule for steady daily levels.

title: DHEA 0.1%–10% Topical Cream (VersaBase)
